themes.title: Trump’s Iran deal dominates global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: President Trump's announcement of a 'largely negotiated' deal with Iran to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz has become a dominant transnational theme, resonating intensely across multiple countries. The coverage highlights both the deal's potential impact and the skepticism it faces from various political factions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump announced the deal, claiming it is 'largely negotiated' and will be finalized soon. The coverage includes his statements and reactions from Republican senators.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media covered the deal, focusing on Meloni's diplomatic stance and Italy's potential role in the negotiations.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish media reported on the deal, emphasizing its geopolitical implications for Europe and U.S.-Poland relations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: British right-wing media highlighted the deal's significance for global security and its reception among UK political figures.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Argentinian coverage focused on the deal's economic implications, particularly for global markets and Argentina's foreign policy.

themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in areas like housing, employment, and social benefits. This theme has gained significant traction in multiple countries, reflecting a broader transnational trend.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox continues to advocate for 'national priority' policies, particularly in housing and social benefits, as seen in their campaigns and legislative proposals.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian government, led by Meloni, has introduced policies that prioritize Italian citizens in social welfare and employment, aligning with far-right rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party has long championed 'national priority' policies, particularly in response to immigration and economic concerns.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway has pushed for policies that prioritize Norwegian citizens in welfare and housing, reflecting similar themes.

themes.title: Mass protests demand Spanish PM’s resignation
themes.blurb: Mass protests in Spain, backed by right-wing and far-right parties like Vox and PP, are demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The protests are fueled by corruption allegations and political scandals, creating a cross-national pattern of public discontent with left-wing governments.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has been a leading organizer of protests demanding Sánchez's resignation, citing corruption and mismanagement.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 PP
countries.note: The People's Party has joined Vox in supporting the protests, amplifying calls for Sánchez to step down.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media has covered the protests, framing them as part of a broader European trend of public dissatisfaction with left-wing leadership.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French far-right media has highlighted the protests as an example of growing opposition to left-wing governance in Europe.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are experiencing a surge in popularity, as reflected in recent polls and election results. This trend is evident in multiple countries, with parties like AfD, Sverigedemokraterna, and Vox gaining significant traction.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD is leading in polls in several German states, reflecting growing support for far-right policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: The Sweden Democrats are gaining influence in Swedish politics, with polls showing increased support.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party continues to lead in French polls, positioning itself as a major contender in the 2027 presidential election.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway has seen a surge in support, reflecting broader far-right trends in Scandinavia.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across multiple countries are grappling with internal divisions, often centered around leadership disputes, ideological differences, or strategic disagreements. These divisions are creating fractures within parties that were once united under a common cause.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS is facing internal divisions over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding relations with the U.S. and agricultural policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's ruling party is experiencing tensions between factions loyal to Viktor Orbán and those supporting Péter Magyar.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's party is deeply divided between factions led by his sister Karina and advisor Santiago Caputo, creating instability within the government.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian far-right coalition is facing tensions between Meloni's Fratelli d'Italia and Salvini's Lega over policy and leadership.
